The Chinese characters for Adam

As a transliteration, Adam is usually written 亚当 (Yà dāng). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

亚
Yà
Asia, second
当
dāng
ought, match

Origin and meaning

Adam comes from Hebrew and means “man, earth”.

About the name Adam

In the Bible, Adam is the first man in the Book of Genesis.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Adam carries the meaning “man, earth” and looks striking in brush strokes.
